desc: Sort arrays A, B, C in descending order.
Use a max-heap to generate the largest values of $A_i B_j + B_j C_k + C_k A_i$ one by one.
Start with the triplet $(0,0,0)$ (indices in sorted arrays) in the heap.
For each popped element, push its "neighbors" (incrementing i, j, or k) while avoiding duplicates using a visited set.
Continue until we pop the K-th element, which is the answer.
Implement the solution in Python, ensuring efficient heap operations and a visited set to prevent reprocessing.
